description: This file defines the MemoryDBClient class for interacting with Amazon MemoryDB service using the AWS SDK for PHP. It contains method annotations for various API operations such as creating, deleting, describing clusters, snapshots, parameter groups, and other MemoryDB resources.

classes.name: MemoryDBClient
classes.description: Client class to interact with Amazon MemoryDB service, extending AwsClient.

methods.description: Method to batch update a MemoryDB cluster.

methods.description: Method to create a new MemoryDB cluster.
